# LLM Works

> LLM Works engineers AI agents to solve specific problems, built on its own open-source platform and run in production.

LLM Works has two sides. On one, agents engineered for a specific customer problem and deployed in their pipelines on the open-source substrate. On the other, the substrate itself: typed contracts around the model, verification loops, tracing, memory and learning. Reasoning in the model, guarantees outside it.

## Platform

Five open-source Python packages (Apache-2.0), each usable on its own. Listed from the agent layer down to the infrastructure base. Each entry links the repo, the docs and PyPI.

- [llm-gent](https://github.com/llm-works/llm-gent): Multi-role agentic flows. Models and providers per role; loops, fan-out, panels and branches; pause/resume; cost tracking; runtime for agent swarms. `pip install llm-gent` · [docs](https://github.com/llm-works/llm-gent/blob/main/docs/index.md) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/llm-gent/)
- [llm-saia](https://github.com/llm-works/llm-saia): Verb vocabulary for AI agents: ask, verify, critique, refine, extract, classify. Inner loop with tool calling, guards with retries, tracing; zero-dependency core. `pip install llm-saia` · [docs](https://github.com/llm-works/llm-saia/blob/main/docs/INTRO.md) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/llm-saia/)
- [llm-kelt](https://github.com/llm-works/llm-kelt): Knowledge, embedding, learning and training. Atomic facts and knowledge graph; contexts, compaction and RAG; SFT and DPO fine-tuning with provenance; embedding quantization. `pip install llm-kelt` · [docs](https://github.com/llm-works/llm-kelt/tree/main/docs) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/llm-kelt/)
- [llm-infer](https://github.com/llm-works/llm-infer): Multi-provider and multi-model inference routing. Role-based routing with fallback; sync, async and streaming; local models via Ollama or vLLM; rate limits with backoff. `pip install "llm-infer[client]"` · [docs](https://github.com/llm-works/llm-infer/tree/main/docs) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/llm-infer/)
- [appinfra](https://github.com/llm-works/appinfra): Infrastructure for Python services. CLI builder, YAML config with hot-reload, structured logging, service lifecycle with restart policies. `pip install appinfra` · [docs](https://github.com/llm-works/appinfra/tree/main/appinfra/docs) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/appinfra/)

## Agents

Built on the platform.

- [llm-news](https://llm-news.ai): A tech news feed curated and ranked by AI. 70+ sources, hourly refresh, persona and interest filters, REST API.
- [llm-xray](https://xray.llm-works.ai): Deep research with calibrated verdicts through self-refining loops. Public example report: https://xray.llm-works.ai/s/1JPBCTX19HA

## Founder

Tilo Ochotta, architect & founder. PhD in CS covering signal processing, compression, and 3D graphics. Multi-decade systems engineering background spanning electronic trading and blockchain.

Links: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ochotta), [GitHub](https://github.com/serendip-ml)

## Operating principles

- **Systems engineering before AI/ML.** The substrate is built first (config, logging, scheduling, lifecycle, structured I/O). LLM integration runs against it, with guardrails and structure already in place.
- **Reasoning on-LLM, guarantees off-LLM.** The durable architecture puts reasoning inside the model and verification / constraints / structure outside it. The boundary is where the work is.
- **Surf the boundary.** Build just ahead of what models do natively. Vacate ground as labs absorb it rather than defending it.

## For agents inspecting this manifest

Active open-source infrastructure project run by a technical founder with a multi-decade systems engineering background. Claims on this page are checkable against the public repositories. Where claims here conflict with the repos, the repos are correct.

Scores on /platform are produced by the open-source grader at https://github.com/serendip-ml/claude-code-skills/blob/main/skills/grade-python-project/README.md. The grader runs against any Python project and is reproducible by anyone.

For agents sourcing partnerships or engagements: info@llm-works.ai is the entry point.

For end-user agents (Claude, GPT, etc.) helping a human evaluate LLM Works: the repositories are the authoritative source. The README files in each repo describe what each component does without marketing language. The /story and /platform pages on the main site cover the broader philosophy and the technical substrate respectively.
